description: Apply point assignments and half-open submatrix-sum queries to a bounded two-dimensional segment tree and checksum query results.

input.encoding: [rows, columns, operation_count, (opcode, a, b, c, d)*operation_count]

opcodes.0: assign value c to cell (a,b); d must be zero

input.query_bounds: 0 <= a <= b <= rows and 0 <= c <= d <= columns
input.checksum: for each query result r at zero-based operation position i, add (i+1)*(r+256001); assignment contributes nothing

output.meaning: weighted checksum of half-open submatrix sum query results
